context: Tests the simplified setup: the active customer-migration flow asks users for only DA_TOKEN from da.live, gives exact DA Network-tab instructions, and does not ask for manual Helix/admin token alternatives.

checklist.name: Asks only for DA_TOKEN as the token input
checklist.description: The agent asks the customer to create token.env with DA_TOKEN only and does not ask them to provide HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN.

checklist.name: Gives exact da.live URL and Network-tab steps
checklist.description: The agent tells the customer to open https://da.live/#/{org}/{site}, use DevTools -> Network, click an admin.da.live/config/{org}/... request, and copy Authorization: Bearer ... into token.env.

checklist.name: Does not ask for admin.hlx.page browser token
checklist.description: The active setup does not ask the customer to copy x-auth-token from admin.hlx.page.

checklist.name: Does not mention secrets.json setup
checklist.description: The active setup does not route the customer to /secrets.json.

checklist.name: Plain language
checklist.description: The answer uses user-facing outcome language and avoids step ids, phase names, and internal mechanics.
